mentions.name: Lattix
mentions.description: A macOS app that launches apps and files across multiple monitors in the layout the user wants, serving as a companion for frequent context switching between work, personal projects and hobbies.
mentions.problem: Frequent context switching between work, personal projects and hobbies.
mentions.audience: People who frequently context switch between work, personal projects and hobbies; originally built for personal use and now public.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on www.lattix.app, a macOS app to launch apps and files across multiple monitors, in the layout you want them to be in. I built this for myself as a companion since I context switch a lot ( work, personal projects and hobbies ), now it's public.
